children.name: FAQ Headline
children.characters: What Providers usually need to know.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Do I have to use Basic, Standard and Premium packages?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Packages are appropriate for fixed-price services, while Providers can also use hourly, retainer, milestone-based or custom-quote models where relevant.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Can I offer more than one service?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Yes. Providers can structure multiple services around different expertise, scopes or client needs.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: What happens after I publish a service?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: A published service can become visible through Marketplace discovery and may also become eligible for relevant ecosystem matching.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: Ecosystem matching connects relevant Provider services to needs that emerge within Creator, Entrepreneur or Investor journeys.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Do I need to search manually for every client?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Clients may discover Providers directly, while Mondial can also surface context-driven opportunities when relevant needs appear.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: A Client Brief is a structured request describing work the client needs, which relevant Providers can review before deciding whether to respond.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Does a high match mean the client will hire me?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Matching indicates potential relevance. The client and Provider still decide whether the opportunity is a good fit.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: Featured visibility can be associated with stronger Provider status and platform performance. It does not guarantee client selection.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: What happens when I want to pursue an opportunity?

children.name: We offer both!
